producer_report.summary: I added `crates/athena-core/src/lab.rs`, with `LabConfig::parse`, `check_run` and `fingerprint`, and exported it from `lib.rs`. I recorded it as the mechanism of OLY-B-S3-01 in `docs/spec.toml`, with a measure ending `status: not shown`. The new `lab_runs` test file passes (7 tests), as do the policy scan, the mirrors test and clippy on `athena-core`. I did not run the full `cargo test`. `parse` refuses a config with no task, no 40-hex pinned commit, no positive USD cap for any of the three systems, or an unknown system. `check_run` refuses a run once spend reaches the cap. `fingerprint` is a hand-written FNV-1a hash, so no new dependency. The new test file is registered in `xtask/shard-timings.txt` and the change is in `CHANGELOG.md`.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S3-01 no longer has mechanism = "none"; its mechanism names crates/athena-core/src/lab.rs, owner stays "Athena", and its measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test file crates/athena-core/tests/lab_runs.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the entry in docs/spec.toml; test spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism in lab_runs.rs asserts each part and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/lab.rs exists, is exported from crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, and defines a lab configuration with the three systems, a task, a pinned commit and a spend cap in USD per system, plus a fingerprint of the configuration.
criteria_check.evidence: lab.rs defines LabConfig (task, commit, caps_usd) and fingerprint(); `pub mod lab;` added to lib.rs; the test file compiles against athena_core::lab.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test lab_runs`: a valid config with three systems and positive caps is accepted; configs missing a system, with a zero or negative cap, or without a pinned commit are refused; a run whose recorded spend reaches its cap is refused; the same config gives the same fingerprint and a changed cap gives a different one.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran the command: 7 tests passed, one per listed behavior.

criteria_check.criterion: The test lab_runs.rs also reads docs/spec.toml and fails if the OLY-B-S3-01 entry has mechanism none, no owner, or a measure not ending in a status label; it fails when lab.rs's validation is removed and passes with it.
criteria_check.evidence: spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism reads docs/spec.toml and checks these. The refusal tests call LabConfig::parse/check_run directly, so they fail without the validation (not run with validation removed). Passes with it.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` as separate commands (or the recorded Athena checks on the final tree); all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all, clippy on athena-core with -D warnings (clean), and the targeted tests.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for this job; no existing entry of docs/decisions.md or records/ is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: Added one entry at the top of Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md; docs/decisions.md and records/ untouched.

open_issues: The names of the three systems (athena, firstmate, hermes) are my assumption; the brief did not name them. Change SYSTEMS in lab.rs if the lab uses other names.
I did not run the validation-removed check, and I did not run the full cargo test.
learnings: Bash hooks refuse tail/grep/cd for the producer; use the dedicated tools.
The mirrors test requires every new test file to be listed in xtask/shard-timings.txt.
